definition: means any hospital, day care centre or other provider that is not part of the network.
plain: Any hospital or day-care centre the insurer has no cashless agreement with.
whyItMatters: You are still covered — but you pay the bill yourself and claim it back, which means finding the money at the worst possible moment and waiting weeks for reimbursement. In a genuine emergency you go to the nearest capable hospital regardless; for anything planned, checking the network first is the difference between an inconvenience and a crisis.
